0.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4GACHA_00943_TYRMARN_000_000
0.description: This punishment of mine is shaping up to be rather exciting! I only thought to sate my intellectual curiosity, you see, but I ended up crossing a line. Or two. Or three...

1.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4GACHA_00943_TYRMARN_000_010
1.description: Bring me anything curious, anything more unnatural than usual, and I'll tell you what it truly is. I delight in all discoveries, but let us hope for something <hex:021A020203>spicy<hex:021A020103>!

3.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4GACHA_00943_A1_000_021
3.description: Appraise a piece of the Accursed or Blessed Hoard.

7.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4GACHA_00943_TYRMARN_000_030
7.description: They may be ruins now, but the churches of the First Light were once abustle with parishioners and pilgrims. And where people have been, so have their belongings!

8.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4GACHA_00943_TYRMARN_000_031
8.description: Among the bits and bobs fallen from loose pockets must hide treasure─treasure from a sanctum's vault, perhaps! Does not the mere thought of it make your fingers itch?

9.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4GACHA_00943_SYSTEM_000_032
9.description: When exploring the deep dungeon, players will, on occasion, find pieces of the Accursed Hoard─treasure abandoned by pilgrims of eld.

10.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4GACHA_00943_SYSTEM_000_033
10.description: You can ascertain the value of pieces found in Pilgrim's Traverse by presenting them to Tyr Marn for appraisal.

11.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4GACHA_00943_TYRMARN_000_040
11.description: Blessings come in all sorts─in golds and riches, in jewels and glass, in the ruddy cheeks of a smiling babe... The very flow of time that brought you to this moment may in itself be providence. Even a simple stone can be a blessing to some!

12.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4GACHA_00943_TYRMARN_000_041
12.description: The significance of any item is bestowed by its holder, after all. And it, in turn, blesses us with knowledge of its former masters. Such very sweet knowledge, indeed... <slurp>

13.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4GACHA_00943_SYSTEM_000_042
13.description: By completing objectives in your challenge log, you may earn pieces of the Blessed Hoard. Speak with Vanthau to consult the challenge log category for Pilgrim's Traverse.

14.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4GACHA_00943_SYSTEM_000_043
14.description: You can receive special items from pieces of the Blessed Hoard by presenting them to Tyr Marn for appraisal.
